rubric: Each criterion: 0 material workaround, 1 manageable discipline, 2 direct verified fit. Applied only after correctness and complete performance evidence qualify a candidate.

domainReuse: Shared completion/accounting functions consume ordinary component payloads directly.
typeSafety: World<Entity> and component queries preserve typed records without module declaration shims.
lifecycle: Synchronous systems and explicit component methods fit the current session; predicate reindexing is covered by the probe.
captureProjection: Native object data maps directly to deep detached records and fresh-world rebuilds.
packageRisk: Small inspectable core and working package exports, but sparse release activity and explicit nested dirty tracking remain obligations.

domainReuse: The same plain completion/accounting functions are reused with per-world payload stores.
typeSafety: Typed stores compile strictly, but query membership does not prove every indexed payload access to TypeScript.
lifecycle: Explicit store initialization/cleanup, ID reuse and typed-array capacity growth require application discipline.
captureProjection: Projection and rebuild translate numeric IDs and separate stores through the adapter.
packageRisk: Working ESM/types and no runtime dependencies; the 0.4 rewrite and removal/mutation semantics require version-specific knowledge.

domainReuse: Shared plain rules work with callback payload traits and schema numeric traits.
typeSafety: Strong inferred trait APIs, with explicit nullable payload defaults and storage-dependent read semantics.
lifecycle: Native lifecycle works, but nested and direct-store writes require explicit change signalling.
captureProjection: SoA records and AoS payload references require consistent detachment; query results allocate snapshots.
packageRisk: Import installs methods on Number.prototype across the host application; the benchmark contains this with fresh processes.

domainReuse: Shared completion/accounting functions consume object payloads without rewriting synthetic rules.
typeSafety: Declared component schemas and access entitlements pass the checked build and strict compilation.
lifecycle: Promise execution, queued system operations, transient handles and per-world component classes require substantial adapter machinery.
captureProjection: Capture and projections run as declared system operations and complete asynchronously.
packageRisk: 0.16.1 needs explicit lib ESM paths and a declaration shim; root main and documented perf subpath do not provide the required Node ESM entry.
